title: LightGCN: Simplifying and Powering Graph Convolution Network for Recommendation

novelty_points.claim: 提出LightGCN，通过去除特征变换和非线性激活、保留邻域聚合，简化用于协同过滤的图卷积网络。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes LightGCN, simplifying graph convolution for collaborative filtering by removing feature transformations and nonlinear activations while retaining neighborhood aggregation.
technical_features: 在用户与物品交互图上对嵌入进行线性传播。
去掉特征变换和非线性激活，只保留邻域聚合。
对所有层学到的嵌入加权求和，形成最终嵌入。
technical_features_en: Linearly propagates user and item embeddings on the user-item interaction graph.
Removes feature transformation and nonlinear activation, retaining neighborhood aggregation.
Forms final embeddings as weighted sums of embeddings learned at all layers.
